Nonprofit, not owned by a media group.
qualifies_reason: Independent nonprofit New York quarterly whose Fall 2026 print issue is current, with Spring 2026 and 2025 issues on sale in its own shop.
what_it_is: A US quarterly of left-wing Jewish politics, culture and ideas, carrying long reported pieces on Israel/Palestine, American politics and the far right alongside essays, fiction, poetry, comics and art criticism. Each print issue is organised as a table of contents of a dozen or so pieces, released to subscribers first and later online, and is complemented by a daily news desk, a podcast and events. It suits readers interested in diaspora politics, antisemitism debates and left movements who want magazine-length writing rather than daily commentary.
